One governed pathway to high-quality post-trade data AccessFintech gives financial market participants a single, trusted source for multi-asset class data, built for the complexity and compliance requirements of highly regulated institutions. Detect discrepancies Detects data discrepancies and exceptions that can create unnecessary funding requirements Generate insights Generates data-driven insights that can optimize your post-trade process and improve liquidity utilization Seamless collaboration Enables seamless collaboration and exception resolution across counterparties’ source systems Data vault Our platform normalizes fragmented data sources by translating data into a common language, enabling more efficient usage and distribution of data. Data ingestion and normalization Accept any structured data format — JSON, XML, CSV, and delimited text — without manual reformatting Ingest data via push or pull methods to support both real-time and asynchronous workflows Automate using a robust, flexible, and information-secure cloud data platform that aggregates, enriches, and distributes financial data through scalable microservices and enterprise-grade ETL capabilities Normalize incoming data automatically for consistency across asset classes and counterparty systems Controlled bridge Our secure data bridge lets institutions collaborate across fragmented systems while keeping proprietary data protected. Entitlements management Grant and manage entitlements, so each counterparty sees only what they are authorized to see Connect via the AccessFintech bridge to exchange clean, interoperable datasets that power critical business transactions across all supported asset classes View non-persistent analytics, surface insights, and enable collaboration without sharing or storing underlying data Synchronized data networks Our platform’s asset class-specific workflows and embedded AI surface the insights your teams need — before problems become costly.
